name: 35120 · Odenville, AL
findings: ZIP 35120 (Odenville) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35120 (Odenville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 35120 (Odenville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).
